editor-keybindings-manager.interfaceChange: The old EditorKeybindingsManager export is removed by the migrated package.
editor-keybindings-manager.replacement: Use KeybindingsManager with TUI_KEYBINDINGS and namespaced ids such as tui.editor.deleteCharBackward and tui.select.up.
editor-keybindings-manager.riskPoint: Keeping a local old manager creates two keybinding state sources because upstream Input, Editor and SelectList read getKeybindings().
editor-keybindings-manager.migrationDecision: Production code imports @earendil-works/pi-tui directly; the temporary src/main/tui/pi-tui.ts package import boundary has been removed.
editor-keybindings-manager.residualRisk: No residual risk beyond normal regression coverage.
editor-keybindings-manager.ownerDecision: Accept migration evidence for this rule under the pi-tui migration matrix.

get-editor-keybindings.interfaceChange: The old getEditorKeybindings export is removed by the migrated package.
get-editor-keybindings.replacement: Use getKeybindings().matches(data, namespacedId) with ids such as tui.select.confirm and tui.select.cancel.
get-editor-keybindings.riskPoint: OpenDesk-owned prompt widgets must use the same global keybinding manager as upstream pi-tui components.
get-editor-keybindings.migrationDecision: AskUser and ExitPlanMode prompt widgets now use getKeybindings() directly.
get-editor-keybindings.verificationMethod: type diff + upstream implementation diff + behavior evidence
get-editor-keybindings.residualRisk: No residual risk beyond normal regression coverage.
get-editor-keybindings.ownerDecision: Accept migration evidence for this rule under the pi-tui migration matrix.

set-editor-keybindings.interfaceChange: The old setEditorKeybindings export is removed by the migrated package.
set-editor-keybindings.riskPoint: Startup key overrides must update upstream pi-tui global keybindings or Input/Editor will ignore them.
set-editor-keybindings.migrationDecision: OpenDesk startup now configures tui.editor.deleteCharBackward through setKeybindings().
